post.summary: Authenticates a user and creates an authentication session.

requestBody.description: A token to monitor for cancellation requests.

200.description: The user was successfully authenticated and an authentication cookie was created.

post.summary: Refreshes the authentication tokens using the supplied refresh token.
post.description:
The CSRF token must be supplied in the `X-CSRF-Token` request header.
The value of this header must match the `csrf_token` cookie sent with the request.
Requests with a missing or invalid CSRF token are rejected with an unauthorized response.

200.description: The refresh token was successfully exchanged for new authentication credentials.

400.description: The refresh token request was invalid or could not be processed.

401.description: The CSRF token was missing or invalid, or the supplied authentication credentials were unauthorized.

post.summary: Completes a multi-factor authentication challenge for an existing authentication session.

requestBody.description: A token to monitor for cancellation requests.

200.description:
The multi-factor authentication challenge was successfully completed and an
authentication cookie was created.

401.description: The authentication session or verification code was invalid.

get.summary: Validates whether a user setup token is valid and can be used to complete the user setup process.

parameters.name: setupToken
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the setup token to validate.

200.description: The setup token is valid and can be used.

401.description: The setup token has expired or has already been consumed.

404.description: The specified setup token does not exist.

post.summary: Completes the setup process for a user account using a valid setup token.

requestBody.description: A token that can be used to cancel the asynchronous operation.

post.summary:
Verifies the user's multi-factor authentication setup by validating the
provided authentication code.

requestBody.description: The token used to cancel the operation.

200.description: The multi-factor authentication setup was successfully verified.

400.description:
The request contained invalid data or the multi-factor authentication
verification could not be completed.

get.summary: Retrieves an organisation by its unique identifier.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The identifier of the organisation to retrieve.

200.description: The organisation was found and its details were returned.

404.description: No organisation exists with the specified identifier.

put.summary: Updates the details of an existing organisation.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The identifier of the organisation to update.

requestBody.description: A token that can be used to cancel the operation.

400.description: The supplied organisation details failed validation.

404.description: No organisation exists with the specified identifier.

parameters.name: organisationId
parameters.description: The identifier of the organisation that owns the membership.

parameters.name: membershipId
parameters.description: The identifier of the membership to deactivate.

404.description: The specified organisation membership could not be found.

parameters.name: organisationId
parameters.description: The identifier of the organisation that owns the membership.

parameters.name: membershipId
parameters.description: The identifier of the membership to reactivate.

404.description: The specified organisation membership could not be found.

patch.summary: Updates the role assigned to a user within an organisation membership.

parameters.name: organisationId
parameters.description: The identifier of the organisation that owns the membership.

parameters.name: membershipId
parameters.description: The identifier of the membership to update.

requestBody.description: A token that can be used to cancel the operation.

200.description: The membership role was successfully updated.

404.description: The specified organisation membership could not be found.

get.summary: Gets the information for the currently authenticated user.

200.description: Returns the information for the currently authenticated user.

get.summary: Retrieves a paginated list of users based on the specified query parameters.

parameters.name: OrganisationId
parameters.description: Gets or initialises the optional ID of the organisation to filter users by.

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description:
Gets or initialises the page number for pagination.
Must be greater than or equal to 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
Gets or initialises the number of items per page for pagination.
Must be between 1 and 100.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
Gets or initialises the collection of user organisation statuses to filter users by.
Users with a UserOrgStatus.Rejected status are always excluded from
results, regardless of the values supplied here.

parameters.name: Role
parameters.description: Gets or initialises the collection of user roles to filter users by.

parameters.name: Email
parameters.description: Gets or initialises an optional partial, case-insensitive match against the user's email address.

parameters.name: LastActiveFrom
parameters.description: Gets or initialises the inclusive lower bound of the user's last active timestamp to filter by.

parameters.name: LastActiveTo
parameters.description: Gets or initialises the inclusive upper bound of the user's last active timestamp to filter by.

200.description: Returns the paginated list of users.

400.description: Returned if the query parameters are invalid or the organisation is not found.

404.description: Returned if no users are found matching the query parameters.

get.summary: Retrieves a user's details along with their role within the specified organisation.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the user to retrieve.

parameters.name: organisationId
parameters.description:
The unique identifier of the organisation to read the user's membership from. A user may
belong to several organisations, so their role is resolved against this organisation.

200.description: Returns the user's details and their role within the organisation.

400.description: Returned if the specified organisation does not exist.

403.description: Returned if the caller is not authorised to view the organisation's users.

404.description: Returned if the user is not a member of the specified organisation.

patch.summary: Updates the details of the specified user.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the user whose details are being updated.

requestBody.description: A token to monitor for cancellation requests.

200.description: The user's details were successfully updated.

400.description: The supplied user details are invalid.

404.description: The specified user does not exist.

403.description: The caller is not authorised to update the specified user's details.

409.description: The request conflicts with the existing data such as another users email.

post.summary: Creates a new user account and initiates the onboarding process.

requestBody.description: A token that can be used to cancel the operation.

403.description: The current user does not have permission to onboard users.

409.description: A user with the supplied username already exists.
